newsitem.title: UK: Oil tanker, bulk carrier collide off New Orleans.
newsitem.headline: Oil tanker, bulk carrier collide off New Orleans.

text.p: An oil tanker and a bulk carrier were being towed to port in New Orleans after they damaged each other in a collision, Lloyd's Shipping Intelligence Service said on Thursday.

The 88,000 deadweight tonne (dwt) tanker New Argosy sustained a hole in a ballast tank and the 33,000 dwt Handy Humanity was holed in her bulbous bow while they were both bound for New Orleans, the report said.
Ballast tanks are not used for carrying oil and Lloyds did not say that oil had been spilt as a result of the collision. No more information was immediately available.
